(ii) जल के साथ कैल्सियम

(ii) Calcium with Water

notes: Q10(i) Hindi says 'वाष्प के साथ सोडा' (soda with steam) but the English translation says 'Sodium with steam' — Hindi 'सोडा' (soda) vs expected 'सोडियम' (sodium) is a printed wording mismatch between the two language columns; transcribed exactly as printed on each side, not corrected.
Q7-OR's (a)(b)(c) parts do not show individual mark splits on this page; the 2+2+2=6 split was printed with the primary (non-OR) version of Q7 on the previous page.
